Return JSON only, with this exact schema:
{"slots":[{"slot":"...","title":"...","background":"...","shape":"...","count":0}]}
Use the slot names requested below. The title is only the large top line (for example, ALPHA 17); exclude the smaller subtitle line (for example, ONE TRIANGLE). Copy that title exactly. For background, use exactly one of red, blue, green, yellow. For shape, use exactly one of triangle, circle, square, star. Count only the large shapes below the subtitle. Preserve image order and do not merge facts from different images.
This is slot image_1. Describe image_1.
